name: Sire Denathrius
guide_text: Most of the time, the quest that you can complete the fastest and easiest is the best choice. For example, a summon or attack quest with a [[Harmless Bonehead||104551]] opener is premium, but without any summons it's pretty bad.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for at most 3 gold. Most of the time, it's 8 gold in 1-2 turns.
